attempts.summary: Created a local CA "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (RHEL 10) via openssl, installed its certificate into the system trust store using update-ca-trust, verified trust with `trust list` and `openssl verify` against the default trust store, issued and validated a test leaf certificate, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1 via systemd-run-scheduled systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect), polled through the outage, confirmed a changed boot_id post-restart, and re-verified the CA trust anchor and openssl verification survived the reboot.
